_comment: Coverage is scoped to the main process + shared code, which is what the custom unit suite (src/main/__tests__/run-all.ts) exercises. The renderer (React .tsx) is covered by e2e/manual testing, not these unit tests, so including it here only diluted the line ratio and made test:cov:check ungateable. FR-008: 'include' alone does not stop renderer files from entering the report — several main-process test files transitively import renderer modules (e.g. src/main/services/__tests__/sentence-buffer.test.ts imports ../../../renderer/src/utils/sentence-buffer), which pulled src/renderer/src/store, src/renderer/src/utils and src/renderer/src/components/workspace/grill into the denominator via c8's all:true. The imports themselves stay (they exercise real shared logic) — 'exclude' below is the deliberate, explicit fix so the denominator can no longer move because an import changed.
